notebooks.title: 复算差商、导数与切线预测
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
from fractions import Fraction
import json
t = sp.symbols('t', real=True)

cells.code:
s = t**2
print("位置表:", [(i, int(s.subs(t, i))) for i in range(5)])
print("运动演示时间/位置/速度:",[(i,i**2,2*i) for i in range(5)])
print("区间平均速度:", (s.subs(t, 2)-s.subs(t, 1))/(2-1), (s.subs(t, 3)-s.subs(t, 2))/(3-2))
for h in [sp.Rational(-1,2), sp.Rational(-1,10), sp.Rational(-1,100), sp.Rational(1,100), sp.Rational(1,10), sp.Rational(1,2)]:
    quotient = sp.simplify((s.subs(t, 2+h)-s.subs(t, 2))/h)
    print("h=", h, "差商=", quotient, "小数=", float(quotient))
print("导数:", sp.diff(s, t), "t=2时:", sp.diff(s, t).subs(t, 2))
h = sp.Rational(1,10)
print("切线预测/真值/误差:", 4+4*h, s.subs(t,2+h), sp.simplify(s.subs(t,2+h)-(4+4*h)))

notebooks.title: 复核求导规则
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
t = sp.symbols('t', real=True)

cells.code:
polynomial = 3*t**2-2*t+1
chain = (1+2*t)**2
print("常数/幂函数/乘积:", sp.diff(sp.Integer(7), t), sp.diff(t**2, t), sp.diff(t*t**2, t))
print("多项式导数与点值:", sp.diff(polynomial,t), sp.diff(polynomial,t).subs(t,2))

notebooks.title: 复算矩形和与有符号累积
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
from fractions import Fraction
t = sp.symbols('t', real=True)

cells.code:
for n in [1,2,4,8,16]:
    width = Fraction(2,n)
    sample_times = [Fraction(2*i,n) for i in range(1,n+1)]
    velocities = [2*sample for sample in sample_times]
    total = sum(speed*width for speed in velocities)
    print("N=",n,"宽度=",width,"右端速度=",velocities,"右端和=",total,"小数=",float(total))
print("符号积分:", sp.integrate(2*t,(t,0,2)))
velocity = 2*t-2
first = sp.integrate(velocity,(t,0,1))
second = sp.integrate(velocity,(t,1,2))
print("两段位移/净位移/路程:",first,second,first+second,-first+second)

notebooks.title: 复算尖点、扰动与基本定理
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
t, h = sp.symbols('t h', real=True)

cells.code:
for increment in [sp.Rational(-1,10),sp.Rational(-1,100),sp.Rational(1,100),sp.Rational(1,10)]:
    print("尖点 h=",increment,"差商=",abs(increment)/increment)
for increment in [sp.Rational(1,10),sp.Rational(1,100)]:
    clean = ((2+increment)**2-4)/increment
    noisy = ((2+increment)**2+sp.Rational(1,100)-4)/increment
    print("h=",increment,"准确/扰动差商=",float(clean),float(noisy),"额外项=",float(noisy-clean))
print("累积函数及导数:", sp.integrate(2*t,(t,0,h)), sp.diff(h**2,h))
print("幂函数原函数:",sp.integrate(t**2,t))
print("常数信息:",[sp.diff(t**2+c,t) for c in [-3,0,7]])
print("取h=0时原差商分母:",0,"；不执行除零")

notebooks.title: 核对级数与泰勒近似
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
import math
x = sp.symbols('x')

cells.code:
print("几何级数部分和:",[sum(sp.Rational(1,2)**k for k in range(n)) for n in range(1,5)])
print("几何级数极限:",sp.summation(sp.Rational(1,2)**sp.Symbol('k',integer=True,nonnegative=True),(sp.Symbol('k',integer=True,nonnegative=True),0,sp.oo)))
for f in [sp.exp(x),sp.sin(x),sp.cos(x),1/(1-x),sp.log(1+x)]:
    print("展开:",sp.series(f,x,0,6))
point=sp.Rational(1,10)
poly=1+point+point**2/2
print("指数近似/真值/误差:",float(poly),float(sp.exp(point)),float(sp.exp(point)-poly))
print("阶乘0/2/3/5:",[math.factorial(k) for k in [0,2,3,5]])
print("调和级数分组:",sp.Rational(1,3)+sp.Rational(1,4),sum(sp.Rational(1,k) for k in range(5,9)))

notebooks.title: 独立复算全部习题答案
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
from fractions import Fraction
t = sp.symbols('t', real=True)

cells.code:
s = t**2
print("题1:", (s.subs(t,3)-s.subs(t,1))/2, sp.diff(s,t).subs(t,1), sp.diff(s,t).subs(t,3))
increment = sp.Rational(-1,2)
print("题2:", sp.simplify((s.subs(t,2+increment)-s.subs(t,2))/increment), sp.diff(s,t).subs(t,2))
increment = sp.Rational(1,10)
prediction = s.subs(t,2)+sp.diff(s,t).subs(t,2)*increment
exact = s.subs(t,2+increment)
print("题3:",prediction,exact,exact-prediction)
print("题4:",sp.diff((1+2*t)**2,t).subs(t,1))
width = sp.Rational(1,2)
rectangle = sum((2*i*width)*width for i in range(1,5))
area = sp.integrate(2*t,(t,0,2))
print("题5:",rectangle,area,rectangle-area)
segments = [sp.integrate(2*t-2,(t,0,1)),sp.integrate(2*t-2,(t,1,2))]
print("题6:",segments,sum(segments),sum(abs(segment) for segment in segments))
print("题7:",[abs(h)/h for h in [sp.Rational(-1,10),sp.Rational(1,10)]])
print("题8:",[sp.Rational(1,100)/h for h in [sp.Rational(1,10),sp.Rational(1,100)]])

notebooks.title: 复算象限与旋转
notebooks.setupCode:
import cmath, math
import sympy as sp

cells.code:
for a,b in [(3,4),(-3,4),(0,1),(0,-1),(0,0)]:
    z=complex(a,b)
    angle=None if z==0 else math.degrees(cmath.phase(z))
    print("坐标/模/主辐角:",(a,b),abs(z),angle)
print("反正切漏象限:",math.degrees(math.atan(-4/3)))
print("弧度与角度:",2*math.pi,360,math.pi,180,math.pi/2,90)
